export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

mkdir -p /run/sshd /root/.ssh
printf '%s\n' "$PUBLIC_KEY" > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 700 /root/.ssh
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e
